items.source_title: Artificial intelligence integration shapes motivation engagement and instructional design outcomes among secondary school students in Morocco

items.original_excerpt: This study examines how the spontaneous, largely unmediated adoption of AI tools in secondary school learning practices shapes student motivation and engagement in Morocco, and what these outcomes imply for the pedagogical design of AI-integrated instruction. … Conducted within a post-positivist, mixed-methods paradigm, the study draws on a structured survey administered to 100 secondary school students (Years 10–12, science and humanities streams) during the 2024–2025 academic year. … Data were collected via Google Forms and analyzed through descriptive statistics, non-parametric inferential tests, and thematic content analysis of open-ended responses. … Results indicate that 97.0% of students report familiarity with AI, and 89.0% use ChatGPT as their primary learning tool.

items.original_excerpt: 目前，教育局按照《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》重點，持續提供分層式、多元化專業發展活動，助力學校規劃與推行人工智能教學；數字教育卓越中心及校本支援服務亦會加強到校支援，收集，整理及分享良好做法；開發教材、大語言模型及網上平台等，支援教師教學與評估數字化；並持續深化與本地、內地及國際創科機構的合作，包括中國科學院、香港教育城、科技園、專上院校及專業團體等，共同舉辦培訓課程，全方位支援教師數字教育轉型。 … 教育局將推出包含AI（人工智能）大語言模型的免費數字教育學習資源大平台，並逐步將「AI教學助理」拓展至更多科目，輔助教師教學和評估工作，讓教師有更多空間參與培訓。 … 如何使中小學數字教育配套設施、教師培訓等與新興科技發展同步，以及如何裝備教師推動家校合作，共同引導學生適當使用人工智能工具進行學習等，都是培訓內容之一，同時讓教師認識如何培養學生以負責任態度應用人工智能，這都是教師培訓的新挑戰。

items.original_excerpt: 為加強中央與地方原住民族教育事務協調，並協助地方推動原教工作，教育部及原住民族委員會每年輪流辦理協調會議，邀請各直轄市、縣(市)政府教育局（處）與原民局（處）代表、原住民重點學校校長，以及原住民族實驗教育學校校長共聚一堂，研討原住民族教育相關議題，今（115）年會議於10月29日、30日在臺中市舉辦。 … 今年會議由教育部主辦，國立臺中教育大學承辦，以「原教AI 愛與希望」為中心議題，特別邀請該校郭伯臣校長主講「AI時代的原住民族教育」，引導與會者探討數位科技與原住民族教育結合之新契機，提高教學效果及促進教學創新，並讓學生有更多機會學習不同的文化。 … 次日分組討論聚焦兩大主題：「AI時代的原住民族教育」由國立東華大學許芳銘教授主持、原住民族語言研究發展基金會Lowking Nowbucyang許韋晟執行長分享；「原住民學生升學種子教師培力計畫」由國立臺中教育大學陳盛賢主任主持、臺中市原住民族教育資源中心林惠茹主任分享，期透過交流激盪可行做法，促進理論與實務的對話。

items.original_excerpt: This developmental research study (Type I) reports the design and preliminary validation of an AI-enhanced game-based learning environment (AI-GBLE) for upper-secondary students. … Following expert appraisal of content, instructional design, and media-technology quality by nine specialists, three per domain, 30 Grade 11 students in Thailand used the environment across eight 60-minute sessions over six weeks in a one-group pretest–posttest validation. … Because the single-group design precludes causal attribution, these findings are interpreted as preliminary evidence—of feasibility, acceptability, and learning-related signals from a developed prototype—rather than as intervention effectiveness.

items.original_excerpt: This study aims to systematically evaluate the usability, acceptability and pedagogical relevance of an AIED-Unplugged learning analytics tool from teachers' perspectives, in order to guide the development of user-centered design strategies and support writing practices in resource-constrained educational settings without deepening digital inequities. … We employed a mixed-methods approach involving nine teachers, who downloaded an AIED-U application and followed a predefined usage scenario according to a think-aloud protocol. … Afterwards, participants filled out the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and System Usability Scale (SUS) questionnaires, taking part in a moderated semi-structured interview guided by an interview script. … The quantitative findings indicated high levels of acceptance and usability, corroborating the qualitative findings that teachers perceived the solution as useful, easy to integrate and supportive of their practices. … The usability testing of the Escreva Mais was conducted with nine teachers from private and public high schools in Brazil.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Journal of Computer Assisted Learning (Wiley)；資料標題：From Design to Classroom Adoption: Teachers' Perspectives on AI‐powered Writing Analytics in Resource‐Constrained Contexts；來源刊登日：2026-10-30。作者摘要報告：研究從教師觀點系統評估一款 AIED-Unplugged 學習分析工具的易用性、接受度與教學相關性，以支援資源受限情境的寫作實踐且不加深數位不平等；採混合方法，巴西公私立高中 9 名教師依預設情境以放聲思考程序使用該應用程式，再填寫科技接受模式（TAM）與系統易用性量表（SUS）並受半結構訪談；作者報告量表顯示接受度與易用性高，教師認為工具有用、易於整合。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

items.original_excerpt: This study examined changes in computational thinking (CT), AI concept mastery, learning motivation, and programming self-efficacy following a tangible AI intervention, and explored the teacher's implementation experience. … Guided by a framework integrating the AI Literacy Framework and the SEAME Model, a four-week intervention (4 × 60 minutes) was implemented with 36 fifth-grade students and one teacher in a public elementary school, using a single-group pretest–posttest design within a mixed-methods approach. … Quantitative data were analyzed using repeated-measures ANCOVA, with prior computing experience as a covariate; qualitative data from semi-structured teacher interviews (during and after the intervention) and observations of all four sessions were analyzed thematically. … Tangible AI may offer a promising bridge to early AI literacy; however, without a control group, changes cannot be causally attributed to the intervention, and these single-school findings are preliminary.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：Journal of General Education and Humanities；資料標題：Tangible AI in the Elementary Classroom: Effects on AI Literacy, Computational Thinking, and Learner Dispositions；來源刊登日：2026-11-01。作者摘要報告：研究檢視實體 AI（tangible AI）介入後，學生運算思維、AI 概念掌握、學習動機與程式自我效能的變化，並探討教師的實施經驗；以整合 AI 素養框架與 SEAME 模型的架構設計四週（4 × 60 分鐘）介入，對象為一所公立小學五年級學生 36 人與教師 1 人，採混合方法中的單組前後測設計；作者寫明沒有對照組，變化無法歸於介入，單校結果屬初步。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

items.original_excerpt: In the present study, 7 middle school mathematics teachers used ChatGPT to create personalized versions of problems in their curriculum to correspond to their students’ interests. … The prompting moves teachers made and their students’ open-ended feedback on personalized problems were examined through thematic analysis. … Teachers’ efficiency when creating problems and the ratings of their 7th grade students who received personalized assignments were examined. … Teachers used prompting to adjust popular culture references and address issues with the depth, ethics, or realism of the problems generated, in some cases showing epistemic agency.

items.source_title: 深化媒體素養議題融入，掌握數位時代資訊防身術～2026年第4次審定本教科用書專題研習

items.original_excerpt: 本院教科書研究中心於2026年9月2日舉辦審定本教科用書專題研習，邀請輔仁大學新聞傳播學系陳順孝教授主講「媒體素養AI增能：數位時代資訊防身術」 … 陳教授深入解析當前AI工具的三大類型，第一類為「生成推理型」（如ChatGPT等），其幻覺風險較高 … 第二類是「檢索溯源型」（如Perplexity等），採取邊查邊答並附上連結的方式，幻覺風險中等 … 第三類則是「封閉語料型」（如Gemini Notebook等），僅根據限定材料作答，幻覺風險最低 … 提醒與會者應透過「可不可驗證、值不值得動用、錯了收不收得回」三個核心問句來評估AI工具的應用 … 期許透過這些實務策略，能轉化為未來教科用書編審與審查的養分
